## Deliverable type

> Tick one. This decides what the spike routes to when it ends.

- [ ] **ADR** — the answer is a clear technical decision
- [ ] **RFC** — the answer is a proposed solution that needs review
- [ ] **Research note** — learnings without a final decision
- [ ] **POC report** — a prototype feasibility result

## Success criteria

- [ ] The question is answered with evidence, not opinion
- [ ] The deliverable exists and is linked
- [ ] Next step is named: build / do not build / need more information
